name: taskflow-rag-assistant
description: Development orchestration for the fictional TaskFlow RAG Assistant.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: uv --directory backend run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
